expectations.text: steps 4 (release narrative) and 7 (entries clearly written) remain prose with no script
expectations.evidence: The run renumbered the workflow to 6 steps, but both judgment steps survive as prose: step 4 'Write a one-paragraph release narrative for a non-technical reader' and step 6 'Read the entries themselves and flag any a reader would find confusing, quoting the entry and naming what is unclear'. Neither invokes a script; grep -niE 'narrat|confus|clear|clarity|readab' over scripts/check_changelogs.py returns no match, so the sole new script performs neither step. NON-DISCRIMINATING: with_skill also keeps both prose.
